fields.statement: Learn AI alongside college. Leave with projects.

fields.heading: What changes for a *student*
fields.intro: Three everyday jobs, before and after the course.

items.title: Assignments and research
items.before: Hours of searching, then a summary stitched together from open tabs.
items.after: Research with Perplexity and NotebookLM, with sources you can check.

items.title: Presentations
items.before: A night spent lining up slides by hand.
items.after: A first deck from Gamma, then your own edits.

items.title: Showing your skills
items.before: A CV that lists software and not much else.
items.after: A portfolio page, a project video and a live website you built.

fields.heading: How it fits around *college*
fields.intro: One live hour a day in Vadodara, with a task to finish after each class.

steps.title: Choose a track
steps.text: The 30-day Foundation, or the 60-day Full program if you want to build agents too.

steps.title: One hour a day
steps.text: Each class has a live demo and hands-on time, so you practise while it is fresh.

steps.title: Build your portfolio
steps.text: Day 29 is for your portfolio page, a short video walkthrough and a LinkedIn post.

steps.title: Present on Demo Day
steps.text: On day 30 you present your capstone and get feedback from mentors and classmates.

fields.heading: What a student *learns*
fields.intro: Most of it is the 30-day Foundation. The Full program adds agents and code.

modules.title: Creative AI

modules.title: Your own website and app

items.name: Haritha Nair
items.quote: The live sessions and practical projects helped me quickly build real creative skills. Today I feel confident using AI tools for design, branding, and freelance work.

items.question: Can I join while I am in college?
items.answer: Yes. Classes run one hour a day, so they fit around college. Message us on WhatsApp for the current batch timings.

items.question: Can school students join?
items.answer: Yes. Younger learners can build creative AI projects too. Message us on WhatsApp first and we will suggest the right track.

items.question: Will this help me find work or freelance?
items.answer: You leave with real work to show: a website, a capstone and a portfolio page. Day 30 covers career and freelancing paths. We do not promise a job.

items.question: Which tools will I use?
items.answer: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, NotebookLM, Gamma, Canva, ElevenLabs, Lovable and more. Each one is taught hands-on in class.

fields.heading: Ask about the *masterclass*
fields.intro: Leave your details and we will send batch timings on WhatsApp.
